Database.//: Off by default: with more than one replica, concurrent instances would race to migrate. Enable per environment, or run migrations as a separate deploy step.

Network.//: Addresses of reverse proxies whose X-Forwarded-For may be believed. Empty means the client address comes from the connection. Anything listed here can choose the address used for rate-limiting and audit, so list only proxies you operate.

Retention.//: How long finished-with data is kept, in days. LocationRecordDays is the one that matters: a minute-by-minute record of where an employee was is personal data, and at one ping a minute per person the table grows by roughly a million rows a month per hundred workers. Set it to 0 to keep everything, which the API warns about at startup.
